t: The Orr Maneuver: From System Crash to Sovereign Resilience with NixOS
s: This article reframes system crashes as opportunities for learning and resilience, using the 'Orr Maneuver' from Catch-22 as a metaphor for mastering managed failures. It advocates for NixOS and a modular 'stonecutting' approach to build anti-fragile systems.
sub: The 'Orr Maneuver': Crashing as a survival strategy, learning from failures.
Lithic Technology metaphor: Motherstone (configuration.nix) vs. Knapping (Flakes/nix develop).
LPvg (Linux, Python, vim, git) as a modern 'Cognitive Video Toaster' lineage.
Amiga's 'Guru Meditation' as an honest crash with actionable diagnostics.
